title: Jongen op de rug gezien
creator: Jacques Van Gingelen
attribution: Jacques Van Gingelen, Jongen op de rug gezien, 1842. Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (RP-P-OB-49.053). Public domain.
background: pale pink-beige paper, etched line, unhatched smock
notes: Etching of a youth seen from behind in a smock and wide trousers. Body, sleeve, hand and both legs of the roam walker puppet are cut from it (archive/recipes/roam.json); the raised left arm and the cap are left out. Second cut: the parts now come through fig-figure2-sheet (retouched from this plate).

title: Tuinman met schep over zijn schouder / Jardinier, Middelbourg
creator: Jean Baptiste Madou (drawing), Guillaume Philidor Van den Burggraaff (lithograph)
attribution: Jean Baptiste Madou (drawing), Guillaume Philidor Van den Burggraaff (lithograph), Tuinman met schep over zijn schouder / Jardinier, Middelbourg, 1825-1835. Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (RP-P-OB-40.259). Public domain.
notes: Lithograph of a gardener with a spade. Only the dark round felt hat (crown and brim) is cut, for the roam walker; the face below the brim and the spade blade are left out. Second cut: the hat comes through fig-figure2-sheet; the crook and void patches still cut here.

parts.cutout: classical: raw plate (no key), hand matte polygon with a jagged scissor edge (1.6 px), feathered 1 px, defringed, pipeline paper rim; no ML matting
parts.retouch: crown and brim along the lower brim edge; face (below y 906) and spade blade (x over 1290, y over 896) left out

title: Walker parts retouch sheet (second cut)
creator: Jacques Van Gingelen (etching); Jean Baptiste Madou (drawing), Guillaume Philidor Van den Burggraaff (lithograph)
attribution: Retouched from Jacques Van Gingelen, Jongen op de rug gezien, 1842, Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (RP-P-OB-49.053), and Jean Baptiste Madou (drawing), Guillaume Philidor Van den Burggraaff (lithograph), Tuinman met schep over zijn schouder / Jardinier, Middelbourg, 1825-1835, Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (RP-P-OB-40.259). Public domain.
notes: Made by scripts/py/figure2_sheet.py from the two plates (https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/200196889, https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/200228151): parts cut, paper flattened to one tone per garment, outlines closed with ruled strokes; nape, under-brim mass, fists and heels drawn in code. No image generator.

parts.retouch: smock from the 1842 back view; paper lifted to one flat tone, hatching thinned, contour ruled; hem trimmed straight under the sash, no flare
replaced: small dark nape (hair under the hat) drawn in code, no face, no pale oval
1825 crown and brim on the first-cut outline; the face below the brim replaced by a dark rounded back-of-head mass, so the hat alone covers the head
1842 right sleeve rotated to hang straight from the shoulder pin, ballooning underside trimmed, shoulder cap and cuff closed with a ruled line
new: the same sleeve cut at the elbow (forearm forward, foreshortened from behind), rounded and lined end
replaced: small closed fist drawn in code in the smock shade (curled fingers, thumb over)
tidy trouser leg, outline tightened, inner edge lined
tidy trouser leg, outline tightened, inner edge lined
trouser leg to the hem, heel and sole edge of a plain shoe drawn below
trouser leg to the hem, profile foot dropped, heel and sole edge drawn below
